manaessencebridge.page.overview0: A catalyst applied to a $(item)Mana Pool$(0) teaches it to convert $(item)Inferium Essence$(0) into mana and back.$(br2)Right-click with essence for one, $(item)Shift+Right-click$(0) for the whole stack. $(item)Shift+Right-click$(0) with an empty hand buys essence back.$(br2)An upgraded pool also accepts essence from hoppers and pipes.
manaessencebridge.page.overview1: The first catalyst. Each later one is made from the previous.
manaessencebridge.page.prudentium0: Tier two. The pool starts accepting $(item)Prudentium Essence$(0), worth four times Inferium - exactly as in Mystical Agriculture itself.$(br2)Made in the $(item)Petal Apothecary$(0).
manaessencebridge.page.prudentium1: Upgrades a tier 1 pool to tier 2.
manaessencebridge.page.tertium0: Tier three requires $(item)Terrasteel$(0), so the Terra Plate must already be built.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Runic Altar$(0) for 100,000 mana.
manaessencebridge.page.tertium1: Upgrades a tier 2 pool to tier 3.
manaessencebridge.page.imperium0: Tier four is only made through the $(item)Elven Trade$(0) - unreachable without an open Alfheim portal.
manaessencebridge.page.imperium1: Upgrades a tier 3 pool to tier 4.
manaessencebridge.page.supremium0: The final tier. Needs a $(item)Gaia Spirit$(0), which means a defeated Gaia Guardian.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Terra Plate$(0) for 500,000 mana.
manaessencebridge.page.supremium1: Upgrades a tier 4 pool to tier 5.
